string.text: Independent Merchants
{HERD} Herders
Leper Caravan
Religious Procession
Itinerant Healers
Tax Collectors
Prisoner Escort
Dowry Procession
We trade where the great caravans will not. What do you need, traveller?
Easy now. The herd has had a long road, but we can still spare a moment.
We walk in faith, and welcome a peaceful traveller.
Keep your distance if you wish. We mean no harm.
The woods have been kind to us today. What brings you to this road?
Our procession travels under a sacred purpose. Speak, traveller.
We carry remedies for those who need them. How may we help?
These chests are accounted for. State your business.
Keep clear of the prisoners. This is official business.
We carry gifts for a wedding. May the road treat us kindly.
The road is long. What do you need?
What news have you heard on the road?
What did you see before you fled?
Nothing certain. The road has been quiet for once.
I trust the source.
Take this with caution.
We fled {VILLAGE}. The roads near our old home are still unsafe.
Travellers say {SETTLEMENT} is under siege. The roads around it will be dangerous.
A large host led by {PARTY} was seen on the road.
Displaced families from {VILLAGE} have been seen on the roads.
I will buy five sacks of provisions for 100 denars.
I will buy one animal for 75 denars.
Take two sacks of grain for the road.
I will buy one portion of meat for 50 denars.
I will buy medicinal plants for 75 denars.
Where do you come from, and where are these taxes going?
We left {ORIGIN} and are taking the taxes to {DESTINATION}.
Who are you transporting?
We are taking {COUNT} prisoners to {DESTINATION}.
Accept 100 denars as a gift for the wedding.
A fair bargain. May it serve you well.
Safe travels.
